sources.upstream_owner: CVEProject / MITRE / contributing CNAs and ADPs
sources.bootstrap_method: Fixed SHA deltaLog, seven-day recent-change priority then bounded backfill to 30 days. Admission uses actual publication date, never CVE numbering year. Newly encountered older disclosures require a material affected/status/score difference against the fixed retained-window baseline; original facts stay unshortened.
sources.incremental_method: Bounded fixed base/head compare over retained 48-hour revision overlap. At 300 files, enumerate every pinned comparison commit and commit-file page; retrieve CVE records at the final immutable head. Equal/late timestamps cannot omit Git changes.
sources.withdrawal_semantics: REJECTED is a source rejection, never unaffected
sources.recovery_method: Resume pending IDs, ancestral log revision or commit/page/file offsets and original window. Diverged histories and a single commit hitting the 3000-file endpoint cap remain explicit gaps requiring bounded delta rebootstrap. Unknown publication/baseline and oversize facts leave the source partial at the current unit. First-time rejections need a proved status change or confirmed baseline absence.

sources.native_id: GitHub repository numeric ID or URL hash
sources.bootstrap_method: Only CVE files belonging to immutable active intel manifest
sources.incremental_method: After completed initialization, compare immutable source base/head and fetch only changed in-scope per-CVE JSON plus newly active intel IDs. Unchanged source and intel SHAs short-circuit after a head check. A same-source new intel snapshot fetches only newly active IDs; inactive mappings expire with provenance.
sources.withdrawal_semantics: Successful complete per-CVE files reconcile only that CVE mapping. Preserve original URL/author/provenance and mapping_history; distinguish source_file_absent, source_reference_removed, selection_limit, and outside_active_intel_set. Temporary fetch failures retain mappings and do not claim broken or ineffective PoCs.
sources.recovery_method: Resume saved scan_ids/offset at original source and intel commits before newer windows. Comparisons at the 300-file cap, divergent history, or unavailable old SHA publish an explicit partial full-scan checkpoint; only completion of that pinned active-set scan clears the gap. Legacy offset-only checkpoints retain their original sorted active-set traversal.
